subject: Request: Permission to publish short customer blurb + screenshot (University Labs)
messages:
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@universitylabs.edu>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Permission to publish short customer blurb + screenshot (University Labs)

Hi Alex,

Hope all is well — thanks again for the time on the call last month. We really value the work University Labs has done with the Redwood inference platform, and we'd love to highlight a one-paragraph customer blurb on our site and a single annotated screenshot showing anonymized query flow (no PHI or student IDs).

Quick asks:
- Would you be comfortable with a 1-2 sentence quote and a single screenshot from your team? We would redact any internal names/IDs.
- If yes, I attached a draft blurb and a mock screenshot (screenshot-proposal.png) for quick review.
- As a thank-you, we can send a $100 Amazon gift card to the person who signs off (processing via our CS team).

If you prefer, we can also publish only an anonymized quote (no screenshot). No rush — if you can let me know by 11 Aug that would be great.

Draft blurb attached: 2 sentences describing how University Labs reduced inference latency and cost.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachment: 2026-08-01_univlabs-draft-blurb.pdf (PDF stub)
Attachment: screenshot-proposal.png (PNG stub)
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@universitylabs.edu>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Permission to publish short customer blurb + screenshot (University Labs)

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for reaching out and for the clear draft — appreciate the note. A couple of clarifying items from our side before we can sign off:

1) Can you confirm exactly what data would appear in the screenshot? We only allow screenshots that do not contain student names, IDs, or any protected data.
2) Will the quote be attributed to University Labs or to me personally? We prefer company attribution where possible.
3) Who in your CS/ops team will process the gift card? We need a short procurement note for our finance team that lists the vendor.

If you can respond with those details and a redlineable PDF, I can take this to our legal/privacy lead for quick approval. We have a product review call on 10 Aug; if it can be approved before then, that would be ideal.

Best,
Alex Morgan
Director, Data Platforms | University Labs
alex.morgan@universitylabs.edu
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@universitylabs.edu>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Permission to publish short customer blurb + screenshot (University Labs)

Hi Alex — thanks for the questions, quick answers below and attaching a redline-friendly PDF now.

1) Screenshot contents: the mock we attached is intentionally generic — it shows anonymized query names, truncated IDs, and no PII/PHI. If you prefer, we will programmatically blur any remaining identifiers (we can share the final file before publishing).
2) Attribution: we will attribute to \"University Labs\" (company-level) and will not use your personal name unless you explicitly request it.
3) Gift card processing: Marissa (cc'd) manages the gift card program for reference participation. She will provide the procurement note and vendor details.

Attached: 2026-08-05_univlabs-draft-blurb-v2.pdf (redline-enabled). I can also mirror the same text into an email if that's easier.

If that all sounds good, please let me know who on your team should receive the final screenshots for sign-off (name + email). We can turn around the final assets within 48 hours.

Thanks,
Vivek
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: 2026-08-05_univlabs-draft-blurb-v2.pdf (PDF stub)

Hi Alex — looping in the small ops note so your finance team has what it needs.

Procurement details for the $100 Amazon gift card:
- Vendor: DigitalGiftWorks, Inc. (we will issue a single e-gift to the designated email)
- Vendor email for invoicing: billing@digitalgiftworks.com
- Redwood PO: we do not require a PO for this nominal marketing incentive; our legal has flagged this as a marketing expense.
- If University Labs requires an invoice sent to your AP team, we can have DigitalGiftWorks issue it to an address you provide.

Attached is a short PDF with the typical one-line payment description we include for AP: \"Marketing incentive for customer reference participation\".

If you'd like, we can send the gift card to the email of the person who signs the final release form.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Thanks — that procurement note is perfect. Please send the final anonymized screenshot and the short release form to me (alex.morgan@universitylabs.edu) and to our legal lead, Priya Shah (priya.shah@universitylabs.edu). We will review and aim to get sign-off by 12 Aug.

We are fine with company-level attribution and the $100 gift card to the person who signs.

Alex
